subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should this issue be resolved by landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the immediate MS Teams migration safety fix, or should maintainers require broader recovery for already archived sources before treating the issue as fixed?
rationale: The linked patch is narrow and proof-positive, but migration archive behavior touches persisted user state and the issue also mentions users who already have .migrated sources.

options.title: Land The Narrow Guard
options.body: Accept the linked PR as the immediate fix for non-empty legacy sources that produce zero visible plugin-state rows, and close this issue after merge while handling already-archived recovery separately.

options.title: Require Broader Recovery
options.body: Keep the issue open until the fix also covers recovery of already archived legacy conversation sources or partial-migration cases.

options.title: Request Packaged Upgrade Proof First
options.body: Ask for a redacted release-to-patched upgrade transcript before accepting the migration behavior change as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Land The Narrow Guard
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR as the immediate fix for non-empty legacy sources that produce zero visible plugin-state rows, and close this issue after merge while handling already-archived recovery separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant history for the MS Teams SQLite store and doctor migration belongs to steipete.
